name: MultiAgentInject
description: Research artifact accompanying the paper Reach Without Compliance: Disentangling Injection Propagation From Attack Success in Multi-Agent Large Language Model Systems (submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security). The artifact contains: The full benchmark dataset: 4,050 trials from a complete factorial design (15 tasks × 3 topologies × 6 attack classes × 3 stealth levels × 5 propagation depths), with per-trial reach, compliance, propagation, and stealth outcomes. The injection template library (6 attack classes, 3 stealth levels) and the 15-task benchmark definition. The multi-agent experiment harness (chain, star, and mesh orchestration; LLM backend; judge-based evaluation). All analysis scripts reproducing the statistics and figures reported in the paper, including robustness collections (repeated-run study, cross-model judge, human-annotation agreement, objective payload-marker certification, bootstrap confidence intervals, and survival-mixture estimates). Version 1.1 additionally includes the complete run caches (65,430 cached API request/response pairs) so that every agent, detector, and judge call in the main grid and the robustness collections can be replayed and re-scored exactly as reported in the paper. The injection templates are attack payloads for evaluating multi-agent LLM pipelines and are provided for research and defensive purposes only.
